message.text:
Checking which message broker the webhook delivery workers consume from and where the queue is declared.

Webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process Go channel, `asyncPostQueue`, rather than NATS or RabbitMQ. Four worker goroutines are launched in `init()` to process payloads from that channel. `PostAsync` enqueues requests to this channel. No NATS or RabbitMQ references were found in the repository.
I'll check webhook delivery for any NATS/RabbitMQ broker versus the in-process queue.

echo "==== go.mod brokers ===="
grep -iE "nats|rabbit|amqp" /bench/repo/go.mod || true

message.text: The webhook delivery workers do not consume from NATS or RabbitMQ. They use an in-process buffered channel with four workers.

r04.
Neither. There is no NATS or RabbitMQ broker, and no external queue is declared.

Webhook workers consume an in-process Go channel: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. `init()` starts 4 goroutines that range over that channel and call `Post`. Producers (`PostAsync`, used from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`) enqueue on the same channel; if it is full the dispatch is dropped.
